description: Toybox 10K wave 2 wild animals: crab, hedgehog, otter, elephant, snail, giraffe, seal, bat, firefly, ant, mole, hippo, beaver, kangaroo (with a joey in the pouch), ape, arctic_tern, and the variants zebra and unicorn (of horse) and sea_otter (of otter). Generated by tools/gen_tk_wild.mjs (spines, stripes, patches and the shell swirl are placed by maths): edit the generator and rerun it, not the JSON.

crab.description: A small round red-orange toy crab with a sandy tummy, two friendly raised claws (named "claw", mirrored: turn or lift to wave and pinch), eyes on stalks and a big smile; six little legs ("legs") that scuttle. The round shell is the head group ("shell"), so a look turns the whole crab body; scuttle sideways by moving it along x. About 0.72 m tall at size 1, 0.95 m wide.

hedgehog.description: A small round toy hedgehog with a tan face and pointed snout, a shiny black nose, little round ears ("ears") and a coat of soft rounded cartoon spines ("spines", brown, gumdrop-shaped, never sharp: turn them a few degrees to bristle); tiny feet ("legs"). Curl up by tipping the whole hedgehog forward. About 0.68 m tall at size 1.

otter.description: A sleek brown toy river otter standing upright, with a cream chest and muzzle, whiskers, small round ears ("ears"), short arms with paws ("paw", mirrored: lift both toward the middle to clap), a long thick tail ("tail") and flat feet ("legs"). Floats on its back with rotation [-90, 0, 0]. About 1.06 m tall at size 1.

elephant.description: A big friendly gray toy elephant with large soft flapping ears ("ears", mirrored, pink inside), a long trunk in three segments that each turn at their root ("trunk" at the face, "trunk_mid" on it, "trunk_tip" on that: turn each by [-30, 0, 0] to curl the trunk up and forward, "trunk" alone to lift it), four thick legs with cream toenails (leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right) and a little tufted tail ("tail"). About 1.5 m tall at size 1.

snail.description: A friendly toy garden snail with a lime-green body that glides on its long foot, a round orange shell with a cream swirl on both sides ("shell") and big eyes on two eye stalks (the stalks are part of the head: wave them with a look or a head tilt). No legs: glide it slowly along. About 0.68 m tall at size 1, 0.8 m long.

giraffe.description: A tall gentle golden toy giraffe with orange-brown patches, a long neck with a dark mane, little ossicone horns ("horns"), soft brown eyes, a sandy muzzle, flicking ears ("ears"), long legs on dark hooves (leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right) and a tufted tail ("tail"). The head group pivots at the shoulders and carries the whole neck: turn "#head" by [70, 0, 0] to bend the neck down low and say hello (the `neck` is the head group; feelings tip it only a little). About 2.17 m tall at size 1.

seal.description: A round smooth gray toy seal sitting up on its tummy, with big dark eyes, a white whiskery muzzle, front flippers ("flipper", mirrored: flap to clap or swim) and tail flippers ("tail"). Flops and swims by moving along the ground. About 0.85 m tall at size 1.

bat.description: A small friendly brown toy fruit bat with a sandy tummy and muzzle, big pink-lined ears ("ears"), big brown eyes and soft dark-chocolate wings ("wing", mirrored, flap slowly on their own). Hangs upside down to rest with rotation [0, 0, 180] (its feet at the top). About 0.88 m tall at size 1 to the ear tips, 1.5 m wingspan.

firefly.description: A small round friendly toy firefly standing up: an orange head with bobbly antennae ("antennae"), a dark body with little arms ("arm") and see-through wings ("wing", mirrored, flutter on their own), and a big round softly glowing yellow tail ("glow", light material: pulse it slowly, under 1 Hz, never flash; color "gold" for a golden glow). About 0.83 m tall at size 1 to the antenna tips.

ant.description: A small cheerful dark toy ant with big white cartoon eyes, a smile, two curly antennae ("antennae"), a tiny red neckerchief ("neckerchief": drop it in a variant), two front arms ("arm", mirrored: wave and carry) and four thin legs ("legs"), six in all; a round thorax and a big round abdomen behind. Recolor charcoal to brown for a red-brown ant. About 0.75 m tall at size 1 to the antenna curls.

mole.description: A small velvety dark-gray toy mole (plush) with tiny eyes, a long pink nose and big pink digging paws with four fingers ("paw", mirrored: wiggle to dig, lift to wave), pink feet ("legs") and a little pink tail ("tail"). Blinks on its own. About 0.82 m tall at size 1.

hippo.description: A large round gray toy hippo with a pink tummy and a big wide pink muzzle, eyes up high, little twitching ears ("ears"), stubby legs (leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right) and a tiny tail ("tail"). Puffs out her cheeks with a joyful feeling; wades with its legs hidden in water. About 1.04 m tall at size 1.

beaver.description: A round chunky chestnut-brown toy beaver with a sandy tummy and muzzle, two big white front teeth ("teeth"), small round ears ("ears"), little arms with dark paws ("paw", mirrored: drag branches), dark webbed back feet ("legs") and a flat dark paddle tail ("tail": turn it [-20, 0, 0] and back to slap). About 1.09 m tall at size 1.

kangaroo.description: A red-brown toy kangaroo standing up on big back legs and long feet ("legs"), with a sandy tummy and snout, tall pink-lined ears ("ears"), little arms ("arm", mirrored), a long thick tail ("tail") and a pouch ("pouch"). A tiny joey ("joey") sits hidden inside the pouch: move "#joey" by [0, 0.1, 0.02] to make it peek out. Hops by moving up and down. About 1.42 m tall at size 1 to the ear tips.

ape.description: A big gentle toy gorilla-like ape with soft dark plush fur, a gray chest, a gray kind face with brown eyes, long strong arms with gray hands ("arm", mirrored), short legs with gray feet ("legs"), small ears ("ears") and no tail. Moves slowly. About 1.42 m tall at size 1.

arctic_tern.description: A small sleek toy arctic tern: a white seabird with a gray back, a black cap ("cap"), a red pointed beak ("beak"), red feet ("legs"), long pointed gray wings with dark tips ("wing", mirrored: turn about z to flap) and two long white tail streamers ("tail"). About 0.57 m tall at size 1.

zebra.description: A friendly black-and-white toy zebra (the farm horse with bold stripes round its body, neck and legs, a dark nose, a short black mane and big brown eyes). Same named parts as horse: tail, mane, leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right (the leg stripes move with the legs), plus "stripes". About 1.5 m tall at size 1.

sea_otter.description: A sleek dark-brown toy sea otter with a pale sandy whiskery face, small round ears, cream chest and muzzle: the river otter's body and named parts (paw, tail, ears, legs). Floats on its back with rotation [-90, 0, 0] and holds a flat rock on its tummy. About 1.06 m tall at size 1.

unicorn.description: A friendly storybook toy unicorn: the farm horse in white with a cream muzzle, a pastel rainbow mane ("mane") and tail ("tail"), a pink forelock, golden hooves and a golden spiral horn ("horn"). Same named legs as horse (leg_front_left, leg_front_right, leg_back_left, leg_back_right). About 1.6 m tall at size 1 to the horn tip.
